name: comp-300

frames.best_why: Frame 3 shows the full toast with message, View, Undo and close, with the cursor well clear.

tagline: Clicking spawns a bottom toast confirming a send, with view, undo and close.
summary: A small outline button that opens a custom notification at the bottom of the screen. The toast shows a green tick, a short confirmation, then View and Undo links and a close icon.
appearance: A dark, rounded toast strip sits low on the stage: a green circled tick, the words Message sent, then View and Undo links split by a dot, and an X at the right edge. A small outlined button labelled Custom sonner floats at the top left.
behaviour: Clicking the trigger raises the toast from the bottom. It fades away on its own after a short pause, or at once when Undo or the X is pressed; the action links underline on hover.
demo_content: Trigger reads Custom sonner; the toast says Message sent with View and Undo.
search_phrases: snackbar that offers view or undo
small success alert at screen bottom
use_when: You need to confirm an action and offer a quick undo or detail link without blocking the page.
avoid_when: It needs a toast host and a third-party toast library mounted, so it does not work as a lone file.
customise: The trigger label and the toast text, icon and actions are written in the file; the toast width comes from a CSS variable on the host.
weight_why: A small button and one notification; the toast library handles showing and hiding it.

a11y.note: Close carries an aria-label and icons are hidden from screen readers, but the code does not account for reduced motion.

issues: View has no click handler, so it does nothing when pressed.
polish_why: Well-spaced toast with clear actions and close; the trigger is an unremarkable outline button.
